hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/simpleterm-antigravity" "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/simpleterm-antigravity" "$HOME/.simpleterm/src/plugins/simpleterm"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/agent-hook.sh" ] && exec sh "$d/scripts/agent-hook.sh" agy PreToolUse; done; case $(head -c 4096 ./plugin.json 2>/dev/null) in *'"'"'"simpleterm-antigravity"'"'"'*) [ -f ./scripts/agent-hook.sh ] && exec sh ./scripts/agent-hook.sh agy PreToolUse ;; esac; printf "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}\n"; exit 0'

sh -c 'for d in "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/simpleterm-antigravity" "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/simpleterm-antigravity" "$HOME/.simpleterm/src/plugins/simpleterm"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/agent-hook.sh" ] && exec sh "$d/scripts/agent-hook.sh" agy PostToolUse; done; case $(head -c 4096 ./plugin.json 2>/dev/null) in *'"'"'"simpleterm-antigravity"'"'"'*) [ -f ./scripts/agent-hook.sh ] && exec sh ./scripts/agent-hook.sh agy PostToolUse ;; esac; exit 0'
